campaign: Gen 6 · ChatGPT BEN64 and Gen7 capture
interpretation: Same-deal common Gen6 and native partnership auctions, swapped partnerships, complete raw records and per-decision timing. Only unused source families enter the followup; a fresh cohort is generated if the source is exhausted.
model_note: Gen6 networks and fast/medium play settings are unchanged. BEN64 uses neural-only bidding and 64 opening-lead/play samples on its own server. New fast/BEN16 games are authorized followups; the original accidental games stay archived.

difference_definition.unit: IMPs per board, candidate minus opponent
difference_definition.bidding: Native minus common on the same board; includes auction/play interaction
difference_definition.uncertainty: Student-t intervals on paired per-board differences; exploratory, unadjusted for repeated monitoring
